column1: # Size and Lifespan -- step 1: animals
# Maximum lifespan and adult body mass for a selection of animals (plus, as it turns out,
# a few things that are not animals).
# SOURCE   AnAge, the Animal Ageing and Longevity Database, build 15 (3 July 2023),
#          part of the Human Ageing Genomic Resources.
#          https://genomics.senescence.info/species/
# CITATION Tacutu R. et al. (2018) Human Ageing Genomic Resources: new and updated
#          databases. Nucleic Acids Research 46(D1):D1083-D1090.
# This is an extract of 194 rows from the full 4645-row database, prepared for the
# course. The values come from AnAge; the selection does not.
# FORMAT   tab-separated, one header row, 11 columns. Lines starting with # are
#          comments.
# COLUMNS
#   HAGRID                    numeric identifier of the species in the database
#   Kingdom, Class            taxonomy
#   Genus, Species            the scientific name, split over two columns
#   Common name               the everyday name, where one exists
#   Adult weight (g)          typical mass of an adult, in grams
#   Body mass (g)             mass of an adult, in grams
#   Maximum longevity (yrs)   the greatest age recorded for the species, in years
#   Specimen origin           whether the record comes from a wild or captive animal
#   Data quality              the database's own assessment of the record
# An empty field means the database has no value for it.
HAGRID
